Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Do not perform the task.", "input": "could you make a compact checklist for thursday morning’s ventilation check at the assembly workshop, for exhaust fan EF-2? the main thing is to look for dust buildup on the inside of the fan grille, but the grille should be removed only if the technician has confirmed that EF-2 is electrically isolated and the lockout tag is visible. both of those things need to be true. if either one isn’t true, don’t have them remove the grille; instead, have them take a photo of the outside of the fan and note whether the lockout tag is visible and whether the fan seems to be running. please keep those as two clear branches so someone doing the check can tell which action applies. this is a checklist for carrying out the inspection, not a report of what happened, so don’t say that the fan passed or failed or that any dust was found. return only the checklist, with no introduction or closing note.", "output": "Create a compact checklist for Thursday morning’s ventilation check at the assembly workshop, covering exhaust fan EF-2. Include these two branches:

- If the technician has confirmed that EF-2 is electrically isolated and the lockout tag is visible, remove the grille and check for dust buildup on its inside.
- If either condition is not true, do not remove the grille. Instead, take a photo of the outside of the fan and note whether the lockout tag is visible and whether the fan seems to be running.

Make clear which action applies in each case. This is a checklist for carrying out the inspection, not a report of what happened; do not state that the fan passed or failed or that dust was found. Return only the checklist, with no introduction or closing note."}]
